title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 3,801–3,850 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 活期支票存款的；支票戶

examples.en: Businesses use commercial checking accounts for issuing payroll cheques and bill payments.
examples.zh: 企業戶習慣開設公司專用活期支票帳戶，以便開立員工薪資支票與大宗貨款支應。

examples.en: She keeps enough funds in her checking account to cover monthly rent and groceries.
examples.zh: 她在活期存款支票帳戶中保留充裕的日常流動資金，用來扣繳每個月的房租與生活採買開銷。

examples.en: Most checking accounts come with a debit card for everyday contactless purchases.
examples.zh: 絕大多數銀行活期支票帳戶皆附帶一張兼具感應刷卡功能的簽帳金融卡，方便日常隨手消費。

examples.en: Update your printed paper passbook at bank kiosks to verify interest deposits.
examples.zh: 長輩習慣定期前往郵局與銀行自動補摺機刷印實體紙本存摺，核對最新利息入帳明細。

examples.en: Many senior citizens still prefer keeping a physical passbook rather than using digital apps.
examples.zh: 許多高齡長輩依然習慣手中握有一本看得見摸得著的實體紙本存摺，更甚於使用手機網銀。

examples.en: The bank teller stamped the newly issued passbook and handed it across the counter.
examples.zh: 銀行臨櫃行員在全新換發的存摺首頁上蓋好印鑑章，隨後雙手端正遞交給櫃檯前的客戶。

words.definition: 定期存款；押金；存入款項

examples.en: Locking money in a one-year fixed time deposit earns guaranteed interest returns.
examples.zh: 將資金鎖在一年度定期存單（定存）中，能享有保本保息、穩定安全的利息報酬。

examples.en: You must pay a two-month security deposit before signing the residential apartment lease.
examples.zh: 在正式簽署房屋租賃契約搬進新公寓之前，房客依約需預先支付相當於兩個月租金的押金。

examples.en: She visited the local bank branch to deposit her monthly bonus check into savings.
examples.zh: 她親自前往家附近的銀行分行櫃檯，將公司發放的當月業務激勵獎金支票存入儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: Daily ATM cash withdrawals are capped at one hundred thousand NT dollars.
examples.zh: 台灣各家銀行晶片金融卡在 ATM 自動櫃員機的每日累計現金提款上限為十萬元整。

examples.en: The bank charges a nominal transaction fee for international overseas ATM withdrawals.
examples.zh: 國人在海外貼有國際跨國提款標誌的 ATM 機台進行跨國提領外幣現鈔時，銀行會酌收手續費。

examples.en: She made a cash withdrawal at the counter to purchase fresh produce from the traditional market.
examples.zh: 她在銀行臨櫃辦理了小額現金提款，準備帶著充裕的零錢現鈔前往傳統市場採買生鮮蔬果。

examples.en: Mobile banking apps allow instant interbank transfers with zero transaction fees.
examples.zh: 透過手機行動網銀 App 進行跨行即時轉帳快速又便利，且每月享有數十次免手續費優惠。

examples.en: He used the banking app to transfer his share of dinner expenses to his colleague.
examples.zh: 他在聚餐結束後隨即打開手機銀行應用程式，將自己分攤的晚餐餐費即時轉帳給同事。

examples.en: International wire transfers require the recipient bank's unique SWIFT code.
examples.zh: 辦理跨國大額外幣電匯匯款時，請務必再三核對受款人往來銀行的專屬國際 SWIFT 代碼。

examples.en: Check your monthly bank statement to verify all authorized debit transactions.
examples.zh: 每個月定期檢視電子對帳單，仔細核對每一筆信用卡與簽帳金融卡的授權扣款交易。

examples.en: Contact your issuing bank immediately if you notice an unrecognized credit card transaction.
examples.zh: 若在手機刷卡即時推播簡訊中發現未曾消費的可疑不明交易，請第一時間致電發卡銀行掛失。

examples.en: Every blockchain transaction is permanently encrypted and recorded on a public ledger.
examples.zh: 區塊鏈網路上的每一筆不可篡改的數位資產轉移交易，皆經過高強度加密並公開記錄於帳本上。

examples.en: Enable overdraft protection to prevent checks from bouncing during cash crunches.
examples.zh: 申請開通帳戶透支保護功能，能在資金週轉短暫吃緊時避免支票跳票或扣款失敗。

examples.en: The bank charged a penalty fee because the account slipped into an unapproved overdraft.
examples.zh: 由於支票扣款時帳戶餘額不足導致未經核准的違約透支，銀行依法向客戶計收了違約手續費。

examples.en: An overdraft facility gives businesses flexible short-term credit to manage payroll smoothly.
examples.zh: 銀行核發的透支循環借款額度為中小企業提供了靈活的短期過渡週轉金，確保員工薪水準時發放。

examples.en: Most Taiwan housing loans adopt floating interest rates indexed to central bank benchmarks.
examples.zh: 台灣絕大多數購屋房屋貸款皆採用與央行基準利率連動掛鉤的機動浮動利率計算方式。

examples.en: A floating interest rate loan may increase your monthly repayment if benchmark rates rise.
examples.zh: 當央行啟動升息循環時，採取機動浮動利率的貸款方案將會相應推升每個月的房貸還款金額。

examples.en: She opted for a floating mortgage hoping central bank rate cuts would lower her payments.
examples.zh: 她選擇申辦浮動利率房屋抵押貸款，期盼未來中央銀行降息時能同步減輕每月的利息負擔。

examples.en: Albert Einstein famously called compound interest the eighth wonder of the world.
examples.zh: 愛因斯坦曾讚譽「複利效應」（Compound Interest）是人類世界中的第八大奇蹟。

examples.en: Reinvesting your stock dividends harnesses the incredible long-term power of compound growth.
examples.zh: 長期將每期領到的股票現金股利全數滾入再投資，能徹底釋放指數投資驚人的時間複利威力。

examples.en: Compound annual growth rates measure an investment's smoothed return over multiple years.
examples.zh: 年化複合成長率（CAGR）能客觀平滑評估一項投資資產在歷經數年牛熊考驗後的真實實質回報。

words.definition: 財商素養；識字能力；知識

examples.en: High financial literacy empowers young adults to budget wisely and avoid debt traps.
examples.zh: 具備扎實健全的金融理財素養能賦予年輕世代明智規劃收支預算、遠離消費負債陷阱的能力。

examples.en: Schools are beginning to introduce basic financial literacy workshops into high school curriculums.
examples.zh: 越來越多教育機構開始將基礎實用財商金融素養工作坊納入高中高職的公民必修核心課程中。

examples.en: Improving financial literacy helps people make confident retirement planning decisions.
examples.zh: 提升全民金融理財素養有助於社會大眾在面臨退休規劃與勞工保險年金時做出明智的科學決策。

examples.en: Generating steady positive monthly cash flow is fundamental to long-term wealth.
examples.zh: 每個月維持穩定充沛的正向現金流收入是打造長期家庭財富自由最堅實的基石。

examples.en: A business can be profitable on paper yet fail due to severe negative cash flow.
examples.zh: 一家企業帳面損益表上看似獲利豐厚，卻可能因突發性的嚴重負向現金流斷裂而遺憾倒閉。

examples.en: Real estate investors focus on buying properties that produce reliable rental cash flow.
examples.zh: 不動產包租公投資人主要聚焦於收購能帶來穩定每月淨租金被動現金流的高投報優質物件。

words.definition: 緊急預備金（六個月生活費儲蓄）

examples.en: Keep six months of basic living expenses in an accessible emergency fund.
examples.zh: 在高利活存帳戶中隨時保留相當於半年基本生活支出的緊急預備金以備不時之需。

examples.en: Her emergency fund provided peace of mind when she faced unexpected medical expenses.
examples.zh: 當家中突發急性醫療開刀住院開銷時，平日儲備充裕的緊急預備金給予了她最強大的底氣。

examples.en: Never invest your dedicated emergency fund into volatile or illiquid stock markets.
examples.zh: 切勿將專款專用的家庭緊急預備救急金擅自重壓投入高風險、高波動且不易變現的投機股市。

words.definition: 通貨膨脹；通膨物價上漲

examples.en: Long-term stock investments protect personal wealth from eroding inflation.
examples.zh: 長期持有優質全市場指數股票資產能有效對抗資產實質購買力遭到通貨膨脹無情侵蝕。

examples.en: Central banks frequently raise interest rates to curb runaway consumer price inflation.
examples.zh: 各國中央銀行通常會透過調升基準存款重貼現利率手段，以抑制過熱失控的消費者物價通膨。

examples.en: When inflation is high, the purchasing power of idle cash kept under mattresses shrinks steadily.
examples.zh: 當市場通膨居高不下時，單純將大筆閒置現金死死存放在床底下只會讓實質購買力年年縮水。

examples.en: Strategic asset allocation between global stocks and bonds smooths out market turbulence.
examples.zh: 在全球股票與防禦性債券之間進行科學的戰略資產配置能有效撫平市場劇烈震盪波動。

examples.en: Your personal asset allocation should adjust gradually as you approach retirement age.
examples.zh: 個人資產配置中的股債比例應當隨著年齡增長與臨近退休年限，循序漸進地動態平衡調配。

examples.en: A simple 80/20 equity-to-bond allocation provides strong growth with moderate risk reduction.
examples.zh: 採取經典的股八債二（80% 股票搭配 20% 高品質公債）資產配置，能兼顧資產成長與防守。

examples.en: Diversify your investment portfolio across technology, healthcare, and energy sectors.
examples.zh: 將個人的投資組合廣泛分散佈局於半導體科技、生技醫療與公用事業等多元產業板塊。

examples.en: Rebalance your investment portfolio once a year to maintain your target risk level.
examples.zh: 每年固定挑選一天為個人投資組合執行「資產再平衡」，將各類別資產還原至最初目標權重。

examples.en: She reviewed her retirement portfolio with an independent financial advisor.
examples.zh: 她與獨立收費的特許財務規劃顧問（CFP）坐下來，全面檢視個人長遠退休金投資組合的健康度。

words.definition: 風險承受度；包容忍耐力

examples.en: Assess your psychological risk tolerance before investing heavily in volatile growth stocks.
examples.zh: 在大筆重壓高波動的科技成長股之前，請務必先客觀評估個人能承受本金回撤的風險承受度。

examples.en: Investors with low risk tolerance should prioritize government bonds and high-yield savings.
examples.zh: 風險屬性偏向保守、心理承受度較低的投資人，應優先配置長天期公債與高利數位活存。

examples.en: Market downturns test whether an investor's actual risk tolerance matches their expectations.
examples.zh: 唯有在歷經真正的股市崩跌空頭考驗時，才能精準驗證投資人內心深處真實的風險承受底線。

examples.en: Institutional retirement pensions allocate significant capital to domestic blue-chip equities.
examples.zh: 大型退休金機構與主權基金習慣將龐大資金核心重倉配置於體質優異的權值藍籌股票資產。

examples.en: Over extended multidecade horizons, equities historically outperform cash and fixed income.
examples.zh: 在拉長至二十年以上的漫長時間跨度中，股票資產的實質報酬率歷史上顯著超越現金與定存。

examples.en: Investing in international equities gives your savings exposure to global economic growth.
examples.zh: 透過投資全球大型股票資產，能讓個人辛勤累積的儲蓄財富同步參與全球經濟的擴張紅利。

words.definition: 股票股利；現金股息；分紅

examples.en: High-dividend ETFs pay quarterly cash dividends directly into investor bank accounts.
examples.zh: 高股息 ETF 每一季皆會將豐厚穩健的現金股息與收益平準金自動匯入投資人的銀行戶頭。

examples.en: The board of directors voted to increase the company's annual cash dividend by ten percent.
examples.zh: 公司董事會投票通過了最新股利分派案，宣布將當年度現金股利發放金額調升一成以回饋股東。

examples.en: Retirees often rely on consistent stock dividend payouts to cover their monthly living costs.
examples.zh: 許多退休樂齡族群高度仰賴每期按時發放的穩定股票股利配息，作為每個月各項生活開銷的依靠。

words.definition: 殖利率；收益率；產出；讓路

examples.en: The high-yield corporate bond offers a competitive 6% annual dividend yield.
examples.zh: 這檔投資等級公司債券提供了極具吸引力、高達年化百分之六的穩定債券收益率。

examples.en: Fertile volcanic soil on the mountain produces exceptional coffee crop yields each harvest.
examples.zh: 高山地區肥沃深厚的火山灰土壤，使當地莊園每逢採收季皆能迎來豐產優質的咖啡豆產量。

examples.en: When bond prices decrease, their corresponding investment yield moves in the opposite direction.
examples.zh: 在債券次級交易市場中，當債券交易市價下跌時，其所對應的債券到期殖利率則會反向上揚。

examples.en: Taiwanese retail investors heavily favor broad-market index ETFs like 0050 and 006208.
examples.zh: 台灣廣大小資存股族極為推崇元大台灣卓越50（0050）與富邦台50（006208）等大盤市值型 ETF。

examples.en: An ETF trades continuously on stock exchanges just like an individual company stock.
examples.zh: 指數股票型基金（ETF）在證券集中市場上掛牌上市交易，能隨盤中股價波動隨時撮合買賣。

examples.en: Investing in a low-cost global equity ETF instantly spreads risk across thousands of firms.
examples.zh: 買進一檔極低內扣管理費的全球全市場股票型 ETF，即可在一秒之內將風險分散至數千家跨國企業。

examples.en: Dollar-cost averaging eliminates the emotional stress of trying to time market bottoms.
examples.zh: 採取每個月定期定額扣款投資法（DCA）能徹底擺脫盲目猜測市場高低點的心理焦慮。

examples.en: By using dollar-cost averaging, you automatically purchase more shares when prices dip.
examples.zh: 嚴格貫徹定期定額平均成本法，能讓你在股價回檔修正時自動買進更多股數以累積籌碼。

examples.en: Set up an automatic monthly debit to practice dollar-cost averaging effortlessly.
examples.zh: 在證券戶中設定每月自動扣款，即可毫不費力、極具紀律地落實定期定額微笑曲線投資。

examples.en: US Treasury bonds are globally recognized as the ultimate risk-free benchmark asset.
examples.zh: 美國財政部發行的長天期美國國債被全球金融機構公認為最安全的零風險基準無風險資產。

examples.en: When global stock markets tumble, investors flock to safe-haven US Treasuries.
examples.zh: 每當全球國際金融市場面臨突發動盪黑天鵝事件時，大量避險資金便會迅速湧向美國公債。

examples.en: The government issues short-term Treasury bills to finance routine federal expenditures.
examples.zh: 國家財政部每季定期標售發行短天期國庫券，以充實國庫資金並融通各項經常性公共財政支出。

examples.en: Guaranteed principal deposit certificates ensure you never lose your starting money.
examples.zh: 保本型定存商品能確保投資人最初投入的每一分辛苦積蓄本金毫髮無傷、安全無虞。

examples.en: Your monthly loan payment is split into paying accrued interest and reducing the loan principal.
examples.zh: 你每個月向銀行繳納的房貸還款金額，主要拆分為償還當期衍生利息與扣抵借貸本金兩大部分。

examples.en: He decided to withdraw only the interest earnings while keeping the original investment principal intact.
examples.zh: 他決定每個月只提領資產增值所衍生出的利息收益過生活，而將最初的投資本金原封不動保留。

words.definition: 資本利得；價差買賣獲利

examples.en: Selling shares after huge appreciation generates substantial long-term capital gains.
examples.zh: 在持股大幅上漲波段獲利了結賣出後，能為長線投資人帶來豐厚可觀的資本利得價差收入。

examples.en: Most jurisdictions tax long-term capital gains at lower rates than ordinary labor income.
examples.zh: 大多數已開發國家的稅法對持有超過一年的長期資本利得，往往提供比一般勞動薪資更優惠的稅率。

examples.en: Capital gains from real estate appreciation boosted their retirement nest egg significantly.
examples.zh: 過去數十年間不動產長線升值所累積的豐厚資本利得，為這對夫婦的晚年退休養老金增色不少。

examples.en: Calculate net ROI by comparing total returns against original capital expenditure.
examples.zh: 將最終獲利所得除以最初投入的總資金成本，即可精準算出該筆投資的淨投資報酬率（ROI）。

examples.en: The automated robotic packaging system paid for itself within two years, yielding high ROI.
examples.zh: 這套導入工廠的自動化機械包裝手臂在短短兩年內便收回了建置成本，展現極為驚人的投資回報率。

examples.en: Before funding the marketing initiative, executives examined its expected long-term ROI.
examples.zh: 在批准大筆數位行銷年度預算之前，企業高層主管會嚴格審視該專案預期的長期投資報酬率。

words.definition: 多頭牛市；股市大漲行情

examples.en: The AI semiconductor boom fueled an unprecedented multi-year global bull market.
examples.zh: 生成式 AI 與先進半導體製程的爆發性成長點燃了一場前所未見的全球科技多頭牛市。

examples.en: In a roaring bull market, consumer optimism and corporate profits reach all-time highs.
examples.zh: 在氣勢如虹的狂飆大牛市行情中，市場消費樂觀情緒與上市企業財報獲利紛紛刷新歷史新高。

examples.en: It is easy to feel like an investing genius when riding a strong secular bull market.
examples.zh: 在乘著強勁的時代多頭牛市順風車時，許多投資人往往容易產生自己是投資股神的過度自信幻覺。

words.definition: 空頭熊市；股市大跌盤整

examples.en: Long-term investors accumulate cheap value stocks patiently during painful bear markets.
examples.zh: 具備遠見的價值投資人在痛苦漫長的空頭熊市中保持理性，逢低分批撿便宜累積籌碼。

examples.en: A technical bear market is defined by a stock drop of twenty percent or more from recent peaks.
examples.zh: 在技術分析與金融定義上，當大盤指數由波段歷史最高點回調幅度達到百分之二十以上即步入熊市。

examples.en: Maintaining a cash buffer helps you sleep peacefully when a prolonged bear market strikes.
examples.zh: 平常手中保留適度的高利活存現金部位，能在漫長的熊市寒冬突襲時讓你安穩好眠不慌張。

examples.en: Cryptocurrency assets exhibit extreme price volatility compared to real estate.
examples.zh: 與穩健的房地產市場相比，加密貨幣市場價格往往呈現出極度劇烈的上下暴漲暴跌波動度。

examples.en: Market volatility spikes around central bank interest rate announcements and elections.
examples.zh: 每逢美國聯準會利率決策會議公布前夕與大選開票期間，金融市場的波動度往往會急遽飆升。

examples.en: Holding low-correlation assets like bonds helps cushion a portfolio against equity volatility.
examples.zh: 在投資組合中配置與股票呈現低相關性的優質公債，能有效在股市巨震時扮演減震靠墊角色。

examples.en: Cash and exchange-traded shares possess high liquidity for immediate emergency conversion.
examples.zh: 活期存款與上市大型權值股票具備極高的資產流動性，能在數秒內迅速賣出變現以救急。

examples.en: Real estate has relatively low liquidity because selling a home takes months of effort.
examples.zh: 不動產房地產屬於流動性較低的資產類別，因為從委託仲介至正式簽約過戶通常需耗時數月。

examples.en: Central banks injected billions into the banking system to prevent a liquidity freeze.
examples.zh: 中央銀行向金融同業拆借市場及時挹注數百億緊急資金，以防止銀行體系面臨流動性枯竭危機。

words.definition: 房屋抵押貸款；房貸；抵押

examples.en: First-time buyers applied for Taiwan's preferential Youth Housing Mortgage scheme.
examples.zh: 許多年輕首購族積極申辦政府推出的新青安優惠房屋貸款專案以圓成家購屋之夢。

examples.en: Making biweekly payments can shorten the total lifespan of your home mortgage.
examples.zh: 改採雙週彈性還款機制，能有效加速本金償還進度並顯著縮短長期房貸的總還款年限。

examples.en: Defaulting on your mortgage can result in the bank seizing and auctioning the property.
examples.zh: 若長期無故違約拒繳房屋貸款，銀行依法有權向法院聲請拍賣抵押房產以強制清償債權。

examples.en: Budgeting ensures your monthly mortgage installment does not exceed one-third of income.
examples.zh: 做好家庭收支規劃，確保每個月繳納的房屋貸款分期金額不超過家庭每月總收入的三分之一。

examples.en: The retailer offered a twelve-month zero-interest installment plan for the new smartphone.
examples.zh: 該 3C 連鎖旗艦門市針對最新款旗艦手機推出了為期十二期零利率信用卡分期付款優惠。

examples.en: Paying off each monthly installment punctually improves your personal credit rating.
examples.zh: 每個月按時全額繳清各項消費分期期數款項，能在聯合徵信中心逐步累積優質的個人信用。

words.definition: 本息分期攤還；攤提折舊

examples.en: A 30-year fixed loan amortization schedule details principal and interest breakdowns.
examples.zh: 三十年期本息平均攤還還款明細表清晰條列出每期償還本金與衍生利息的遞減走勢。

examples.en: During early loan amortization, the vast majority of each payment covers interest rather than principal.
examples.zh: 在長期貸款分期攤還的最初幾年中，每期繳納的大部分金額幾乎都用在支付龐大的利息開銷。

examples.en: The financial planner calculated an amortization chart showing early payoff savings.
examples.zh: 財務顧問精確計算並列印出一份本息攤還分析圖表，展示提前部分還本所能省下的可觀利息。

examples.en: Paying credit card balances on time maintains a pristine 800-point credit score.
examples.zh: 養成每期全額準時繳清信用卡帳單的良好習慣，能維持高達八百分的滿分聯徵個人信用評分。

examples.en: Lenders check your credit score before determining the interest rate on personal car loans.
examples.zh: 銀行在核定信用貸款或汽車貸款的放款利率時，會首先調閱聯徵中心評估個人信用評分水準。

examples.en: Maintaining a low credit utilization ratio helps boost your overall credit score quickly.
examples.zh: 隨時保持低比例的信用卡額度使用率，是快速拉升並優化個人聯徵信用評分的實用秘訣。

examples.en: Avoid paying only minimum dues to prevent crushing 15% revolving interest debt.
examples.zh: 千萬不要只繳納信用卡最低應繳金額，以免背負年利率高達百分之十五的沉重循環信用利息。

examples.en: The revolving door spun smoothly as visitors entered the corporate skyscraper.
examples.zh: 隨著各國洽公貴賓依序走入氣派的企業總部摩天大樓，門廳中央的旋轉大門平穩轉動。

examples.en: Getting trapped in credit card revolving balances makes escaping debt exceedingly difficult.
examples.zh: 一旦不慎深陷高額信用卡循環利息與違約金的泥淖中，將會讓清償債務的過程變得極度艱難。

examples.en: Premium credit cards reward frequent dining with unlimited 3% cash back.
examples.zh: 頂級哩程與消費神卡針對全台指定餐廳與外送平台消費提供無上限百分之三現金回饋。

examples.en: She accumulated two hundred dollars in cash back rebates from her grocery purchases this year.
examples.zh: 透過日常超市生鮮採買刷卡，她今年光是在信用卡帳單上就累積折抵了兩百美元的現金回饋。

examples.en: Some online payment platforms offer automatic cash back deposits into linked bank accounts.
examples.zh: 部分電子行動支付工具支援將累積的消費刷卡金現金回饋，自動無痛轉入綁定的銀行存戶中。

examples.en: Pay your annual health insurance premium via automatic bank debit for discounts.
examples.zh: 設定透過銀行帳戶自動轉帳扣繳每年度醫療險保險費，通常可享有百分之一的保費折扣。

examples.en: Customers are willing to pay a premium price for organic, ethically sourced foods.
examples.zh: 崇尚健康與環保的當代消費者，非常樂意多付一點溢價金額購買有產銷履歷認證的有機食材。

examples.en: The company introduced a premium tier offering ad-free streaming and 4K downloads.
examples.zh: 串流影音平台隆重推出了頂級尊榮付費會員方案，提供全程無廣告插播與 4K 離線下載特權。

words.definition: 保險理賠金；派彩分配金

examples.en: The critical illness insurance payout covered cancer therapy and living expenses.
examples.zh: 重大傷病險的一次性高額保險理賠給付金及時支應了昂貴的標靶藥物治療與生活休養開銷。

examples.en: He received a substantial lump-sum severance payout when the factory closed.
examples.zh: 在工廠因應產業轉型宣布關廠之際，他在工會協助下順利領取了一筆優渥的法定資遣費結算金。

examples.en: The lottery jackpot payout was deposited securely into the winner's trust account.
examples.zh: 威力彩頭獎的高額中獎彩金給付，由台灣彩券公司專人安全護送匯入中獎人指定的信託專戶。

examples.en: Employers contribute mandatory monthly 6% payments into each worker's Labor Pension fund.
examples.zh: 雇主依法必須每個月按時為勞工提繳至少百分之六的勞工退休金至勞保局個人專屬退休金專戶。

examples.en: Employees who participate in voluntary pension top-ups enjoy significant tax advantages.
examples.zh: 選擇主動自願參與額外百分之六勞退自提的上班族同仁，能享有極為實質的所得稅扣除節稅優惠。

examples.en: He retired comfortably at sixty-five, supported by his public service monthly pension.
examples.zh: 他在六十五歲時光榮屆齡退休，每個月按時入帳的公務人員月退休金年金讓他晚年生活衣食無憂。

words.definition: 可從所得扣除的；保險自負額

examples.en: Voluntary 6% pension contributions are 100% tax deductible from annual income.
examples.zh: 勞工自主額外提繳百分之六退休金（自提6%），該提繳金額全額享有免列入當年度所得扣繳節稅。

examples.en: The auto insurance policy has a five-hundred-dollar deductible before collision benefits apply.
examples.zh: 這份車碰車車體損失險保單約定包含五百美元的自負額，超出該門檻的修車費用由保險全額給付。

examples.en: Charitable donations to certified nonprofit charities are fully tax deductible on your return.
examples.zh: 將善款捐贈給經政府依法立案評鑑優良的公益慈善基金會，其捐款收據皆可全額列報列舉扣除。

words.definition: 財務自由提早退休運動 (FIRE)

examples.en: The global FIRE movement advocates aggressive saving to retire in your forties.
examples.zh: 風靡全球白領青年的「FIRE運動」提倡透過極簡高儲蓄率與被動投資，實現在四十歲提早退休。

examples.en: Practicing FIRE principles requires keeping fixed living expenses lean while investing the surplus.
examples.zh: 踐行 FIRE 財務自由精神的核心在於將每月固定生活開銷維持精簡，並將所有結餘全數滾入指數。

examples.en: Achieving 'Lean FIRE' means living on minimal expenses funded entirely by investments.
examples.zh: 達成所謂的「極簡式財務自由（Lean FIRE）」，意味著過著質樸簡約、完全由投資被動收入支應的生活。

words.definition: 被動收入（股息、房租、版稅）

examples.en: Building multiple streams of passive income frees your time for personal passions.
examples.zh: 打造涵蓋股票股息與不動產租金的多元被動收入來源，能將寶貴時間留給真正熱愛的事物。

examples.en: Rental properties and dividend stocks are proven pillars of reliable passive income.
examples.zh: 收租不動產與優質高股息指數基金，被公認為建構家庭長期穩定被動現金流的兩大核心支柱。

examples.en: Writing a bestselling e-book can generate royalty-based passive income for years to come.
examples.zh: 撰寫並上架一本叫好又叫座的暢銷電子書，能在未來數年間持續為作者帶來穩定的版稅被動收入。

examples.en: May is Taiwan's nationwide individual comprehensive income tax filing season.
examples.zh: 每年的五月份是全台灣全體納稅義務人辦理個人綜合所得稅網路申報報稅的法定季節。

examples.en: Electronic tax filing with your digital citizen certificate takes less than fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 善用健保卡網路註冊或自然人憑證進行手機線上網路報稅，通常不到十五分鐘即可輕鬆辦結。

examples.en: The clerk finished filing the medical records alphabetically in the clinic archive.
examples.zh: 診所行政助理依據姓氏英文字母順序，將病患近十年的實體紙本病歷完整歸檔存放在檔案庫房。

examples.en: Claiming elderly dependent parents increases your total personal tax exemption allowance.
examples.zh: 報稅時申報撫養年滿七十歲以上的尊親屬直系長輩能享有加成扣抵的綜合所得稅個人免稅額度。

examples.en: Diplomatic personnel enjoy personal customs duty exemptions under international conventions.
examples.zh: 各國駐外使領館外交官依據維也納外交關係公約享有隨身行李免受海關關稅查驗之免稅豁免權利。

examples.en: The government granted a temporary tax exemption to encourage green energy investments.
examples.zh: 政府針對重大離岸風電與太陽能綠色能源新創投資案，正式核准了為期五年的營利事業所得稅免稅。

examples.en: Progressive taxation levies higher percentage tax brackets on higher earners.
examples.zh: 綜合所得稅採行量能課稅累進稅率制度，依所得高低劃分為百分之五至四十等不同稅率級距。

examples.en: An unexpected year-end bonus pushed his marginal earnings into a higher tax bracket.
examples.zh: 歲末年終獲得了一筆豐厚的特別獎金，讓他該年度最後一部分收入跨入了更高的邊際稅率級距。

examples.en: He installed heavy-duty steel shelf brackets to support his extensive home book collection.
examples.zh: 他在書房牆面上鎖上了加厚烤漆鋼製的重型層板托架支架，用來穩固承重滿滿的藏書。

examples.en: Progressive income tax systems aim to reduce socio-economic wealth inequality.
examples.zh: 累進稅率所得稅制度的核心宗旨是為了落實所得重分配，適度縮小社會貧富差距。

examples.en: The tech startup fosters a progressive company culture emphasizing diversity and flexibility.
examples.zh: 這家矽谷新創科技公司積極倡導充滿前瞻進步意識的企業文化，極力推崇多元包容與彈性遠端。

examples.en: Glaucoma is a progressive optical condition that requires ongoing medical monitoring.
examples.zh: 青光眼是一種隨著年齡增長而逐漸惡化的進行性視神經退化疾病，需要長期回診追蹤眼壓。

examples.en: True lasting wealth encompasses good health, joyful relationships, and financial peace.
examples.zh: 真正長久的人生財富不僅止於銀行存摺數字，更包含了強健的體魄、和睦的人際與內心的平靜。

examples.en: The ancient island nation possessed immense agricultural wealth and mineral deposits.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的古老島國境內擁有無比豐饒的農業穀倉資源與儲量龐大的珍貴地下礦產。

examples.en: The senior mentor shared a wealth of practical experience with the rookie programmers.
examples.zh: 資深技術總監毫無保留地將自己數十年來積累的豐富實戰開發除錯經驗，傳授給新進工程師。

examples.en: Financial independence gives you the power to choose work based on joy, not survival.
examples.zh: 實現財務獨立（Financial Independence）賦予了您完全依循個人熱情而非為了餬口而工作的底氣。

examples.en: Citizens gathered across the capital city to celebrate the nation's 50th Independence Day.
examples.zh: 全國各地的廣大群眾紛紛走上首都廣場與林蔭大道，熱情歡慶國家獨立建國五十週年的光輝國慶。

examples.en: Encouraging children to tidy their toys promotes early independence and responsibility.
examples.zh: 從小耐心鼓勵幼兒在玩耍後自己收拾玩具歸位，能從小扎根培養孩子的自主獨立性與責任感。

examples.en: Prudent money management balances smart long-term investments with enjoyable living.
examples.zh: 審慎精明的金錢管理哲學懂得在兼顧長線穩健投資與維持高品質精彩生活之間取得完美平衡。

examples.en: It is prudent to have an experienced mechanic inspect a used car before purchasing.
examples.zh: 在正式掏錢簽約購買中古二手汽車之前，先請一位經驗豐富的修車技師到場詳細驗車是十分審慎穩妥的。

examples.en: Prudent financial planning requires accounting for worst-case medical scenarios.
examples.zh: 唯有在財務規劃中將可能發生的重大傷病等最壞情況完整納入考量，才稱得上是審慎前瞻的理財。

examples.en: Adopting a mindset of abundance attracts prosperity and generous living.
examples.zh: 抱持富足豐盛的心態（Abundance Mindset）看待世界能吸引更多良善財富並樂於慷慨分享。

examples.en: The autumn orchard yielded an abundance of crisp sweet apples and golden pears.
examples.zh: 經歷一整年的悉心灌溉照料，深秋時節的山間果園迎來了香甜酥脆蘋果與金黃多汁水梨的大豐收。

examples.en: A life of abundance begins with feeling deeply thankful for what you already have today.
examples.zh: 一個充滿豐盛富足的人生，往往始於對自己當下所擁有的一切微小美好心存由衷感恩與知足。

words.definition: 傳承資產；精神遺產；歷史遺產

examples.en: Wise family estate planning leaves an honorable legacy for future generations.
examples.zh: 提早做好完善合法的家族資產傳承與信託規劃，能為子孫後代留下深厚可貴的精神與物質遺產。

examples.en: The pioneering scientist left behind a lasting scientific legacy that transformed medicine.
examples.zh: 這位奠基醫學發展的泰斗科學家為後世留下了彪炳史冊的科學遺產，徹底顛覆了現代傳染病治療。

examples.en: Legacy software systems inside the enterprise are scheduled for full cloud migration next quarter.
examples.zh: 企業內部行之有年的老舊架構傳統遺留軟體系統（Legacy Systems），預計於下一季全面遷移至雲端。
